apply.confirmKeepTab: Keep this tab open while it runs.
apply.confirmBuild: This server builds its own images, so the apply includes a Docker build. The first one can take several minutes.
apply.confirmReference: These saved values are a new reference. Recreating the gateway is not needed.
apply.keepTabOpen: Do not close this tab. The panel comes back on its own.
